notes.title: Patch Notes 0.3149
notes.content:
Patch Notes; 0.3149

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31395800/4f79704bdc467f1881bab8bc093b2d7b3af82c11.jpg[/img]


*  We are pleased to announce that we now have working weapons, tools and mount switch from 3rd person view. 


*  Newly implemented Autosave that can be set in settings and is only saved by the host.  We improved saving so that if by chance you lose the connection you will still be able to continue playing the game.


*  Brand new hot/cold feature has been added making survival all the more difficult, challenging and fun!


  How does this work? Rays from the sunlight will heat you up as well as your campfire.  A little H2O or visiting the winter island will assist you in keeping cool.  A quick swim or drink of water will cool you down immediately.


*  The animal sync has been rewritten completely. 


*  Tamed animals including the animal guards have an Attack/Passive stance triggered with B (follow/unfollow) is still V.


*  Dragon Mounts have a different increase attack range/damage and health output.  Now when you have an Animal, Dragon or Ship as the driver, your health goes up for that time being while on the Mount, to reflect it's stats.
  
 ** Epic Supporters Mounts have the highest range, damage and health stat of all Dragon Mounts**

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31395800/14bb56937dbddf1fddadf58424748ce38d4c224d.jpg[/img]

* Multiplayer loot boxes have been rewritten and work stable through all our testing.  To prevent crashes for accessing the same memory field when two or more people access a loot box.
  The host will be in charge of all the loot boxes and lock/unlock permissions for each player.

*  CTRL + Shortkey will mount / dismount your Spirit Animal or Mount when on the ground (walking animation of mount indicates that you are on the ground)

* Not a new thing, but worth mentioning  a.) always wait for the chat box to appear, this is a indicator that all saves have been loaded in and multiplayer 
connection has been established,(~5 second wait time).

* We are building the dedicated servers right now, so for the time being please either use Single Player or create your own Multiplayer matches,
because of the Save/Load and Animal Spawn system changes.

 

We hope you enjoy these changes and updates, thank you kindly for your support.


Your SAS Dev Team :)

notes.title: New Patch 0.3131 is LIVE
notes.content:
New Patch 0.3131 included are the following fixes and content additions;


*Major Update on Crafting

- All game objects placed in the world can now be picked up.

- Building pieces will drop resource chests rather than the item itself.  With only a small loss in resource quantity.

- Platform with Stairs can be used as flat grounds to place building pieces on top of it.  For this reason, there are no resource cost or level requirements needed for these.  
  Meaning you can use as many as you like.  They do have a snap function, however, it's heavily depending on the terrain so it may be slightly off at times.


*The following building pieces have been added;

- Castle pieces have been added, these include Watch Tower and Bridge.

- Throne Room

- Barracks (will house soldiers in an upcoming patch) 

- Blacksmith with active Anvil and Furnace 

- Player House

- Windmill (will be used for converting wheat to flour with upcoming patch)

- Storage Building, this building will house and spawn Chickens and Sheep.  Chickens now lay eggs and Sheep produce wool.

- Stables, which will house Horses, Cows, Dingos 

- Desert Fort, which is 4 times the size of the Wooden Fort.  Included with this Desert Fort are 2 active cannons.


*Flat areas have been added to the environment.  The shovel icon located on the compass will lead you to the flat surfaced areas.  
  This ensures you can build on even ground, should you choose to do so.


*Additional Fixes 

- Animal hitboxes

- Animals can now climb 50-degree hills

- Navigation AI mesh has been rebaked

- Several animals have been readjusted to now be either passive or fearful.  For example, the turtle and the fox are no longer aggressive. 



** Please note** To see these updates live, please create a single player match or an undedicated multiplayer match.  
These updates for dedicated server will be available at a later time.



Thank you kindly for your support.  

Your SAS DEV Team

notes.title: New Patch coming soon, Dedicated Match rooms will open up soon
notes.content:
Hello there,

first of all thank you all for helping us shape this game and bring it to the level it should be, with your support, bug reports and suggestions we are on a great way to improve the gameplay and add more content that is wanted by the community. Like all multiplayer early access and even full released titles, we have to tweak and fix bugs as they are reported

For this reason, we have done already two patches since launch and one more is coming today and right after that, the dedicated official server match rooms will be going up again. 

In the meantime please either Host or Join a Matchroom of your own or someone already running it. 

Please remember the Matchroom name and next time you want to play where you left off you have to enter the exact name and host it again.

We know with a multiplayer game like this a lot of things can happen and we 
are very thankful for your bug reports.

If you don't see the chat on the left bottom corner please try to rejoin the match if you joined someone. After you see the chatbox (which can be disabled as well by clicking on its header) you should be fully connected to the match. 

Please as well give the loading some time, we are aware of long loading times, but your FPS in the game should be great because on how the game has
loaded the match.

So if something is not appearing right, glitching for you or you don't see the chat, please try to rejoin or create your own match room and see if this is still
the case. 

For disabling PVP when creating a match, simply deselect the checkbox PVP at Match creation.

We are planning to bring out patches (bug fixes and improvements) as soon as we can, it's only 3 of us and we try to respond to your comments and help requests as well. 

We really hope from the bottom of our hearts that you enjoy the game and
see the potential in it and give it a fair try, that's all we ask. This game has
a lot to offer and cannot be judged in under 1hr playtime. 

Thank you for being a part of this amazing adventure, we will do our best
to give you a long and fulfilling experience with SAS.

Thanks 

SAS DEV TEAM
